faq.title: ## Frequently asked questions
faq.description:
Discover answers to your questions about Vinovardag's unique wine experiences and services.

Questions? Get in touch at hello@vinovardag.com

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide a range of services including sommelier consultations, wine tastings, and culinary experiences. Our offerings are tailored to meet the needs of private guests, travellers and companies. Each experience is designed to highlight the best of Nordic wine culture.

items.question: How can I book?
items.answer: You can book our services by contacting us via email or through the contact form on our website. For customized experiences, we recommend reaching out directly so we can tailor the experience to your preferences.

items.question: Do you offer tastings?
items.answer: Yes, we offer a variety of wine tastings featuring carefully selected wines from around the world, with special attention to boutique wineries and Nordic wines. Our tastings can be paired with local delicacies for a complete culinary experience.

items.question: I don't drink alcohol, can I still participate?
items.answer: Absolutely! We offer non-alcoholic alternatives for all our tastings and experiences. Our goal is to create inclusive experiences where everyone can enjoy the culinary journey, regardless of their beverage preferences. Just mention it when you first get in touch and we will tailor the experience to you.

items.question: Can you cater for allergies or dietary needs?
items.answer: Yes. Our cooking includes vegetarian dishes and alcohol-free alternatives are always available. Tell us about any allergies or dietary requirements when you get in touch and we will adapt the experience.

items.question: Are your experiences customizable?
items.answer: Yes, most of our experiences can be customized to meet your specific preferences and needs. Whether you're looking for a private wine tasting, a corporate event, or a specialized culinary experience, we can work with you to create the perfect offering.

items.question: What is your location?
items.answer: We are located in Kiruna, Sweden, the northernmost city in Swedish Lapland. Situated 145 km north of the Arctic Circle, Kiruna offers a magical setting with the northern lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer. Our location provides the perfect backdrop for exceptional wine experiences surrounded by Lapland's pristine wilderness and stunning natural beauty.

items.title: ### Sustainability at Heart
items.text: Rooted in the breathtaking landscapes of Swedish Lapland, sustainability guides our choices. We partner with vineyards that share our respect for the environment and strive to deliver authentic wine experiences that honor nature's balance and the purity of our Arctic home.

items.title: ### Ethically Sourced, Exceptionally Crafted
items.text: We believe that great wine tells a story of integrity. That's why we meticulously select wines from producers who are committed to ethical practices, ensuring every bottle reflects quality, responsibility, and a deep respect for the craft and the people behind it.

items.title: ### Fostering Community & Connection
items.text: Vinovardag is dedicated to enriching our community by creating shared experiences. We aim to connect people through the joy of wine, celebrating local culture and fostering a welcoming space for discovery, learning, and genuine human connection in the heart of Swedish Lapland.

items.quote:
We chose Hanna to select the wines for our wedding because we were truly impressed by her professionalism and genuine passion for wine. hannaProfile.title: ## About me – your host and sommelier
hannaProfile.bio:
As a certified sommelier originally from Finnish Lapland and now rooted in Swedish Lapland, I have an Arctic perspective on the world of wine.

Born to a reindeer herder and a restaurateur, my life has always been a blend of the wild and the welcoming. I was raised at the intersection of wild nature and Arctic hospitality, where I learned early on that a table is only as good as the heart behind it. Today, as a certified Sommelier rooted in Swedish Lapland, I bring that dual heritage to every glass I pour and to every guest I meet.

I started my formal wine education in Stockholm, where I was lucky enough to graduate top of my class at the Scandinavian Wine Academy. Since then, I've added a WSET Level 3 to my toolkit and spent countless hours in wineries across the globe. I don't think of myself as having 'finished' my studies; I'm still exploring and learning every day to make sure I'm bringing the best, most current knowledge to the table.

My true passion is hosting unpretentious, easy-going, and comfortable gatherings. I do my best to create a relaxed space where guests from all over the world can connect, ensuring every meeting feels like a warm conversation among friends.

From curious beginners to lifelong connoisseurs, everyone is welcome. Join me at my home table or by the fire in a traditional Lappish teepee for an experience that blends new knowledge with a heartfelt connection to our land.

hero.title: # Arctic Home Invitations in Old Kiruna
hero.description:
Experience the true heart of Swedish Lapland through the eyes of a local family. We invite you into our private home in Kiruna's historic Old Town, a soulful residence built in 1914 that captures the spirit of a century gone by. Recently renovated to blend its heritage with a fresh and modern aesthetic, our home offers a warm and personal backdrop far removed from the typical tourist paths.

Your host is a certified Sommelier who balances professional expertise with the authentic and grounded reality of Arctic life. This is not just an activity; it is an invitation to sit at our table, meet our whole family and share in the stories that make this region so unique.

service.title: ### Nordic Wine Tasting: A Sommelier's Selection
service.description:
Discover the surprising world of cool-climate viticulture and Nordic flavors. This intimate session strips away the pretense of formal tasting and replaces it with genuine conversation and expert insight.

You will enjoy a carefully selected journey through high-quality wines with a focus on how they harmonize with the subarctic environment. Each glass is accompanied by hand-picked light snacks inspired by the local larder. The vibe is warm and relaxed. Alcohol-free alternatives available. Possible to arrange outdoors in nature.
service.altText: Nordic wine tasting at Vinovardag in Kiruna

service.title: ### Heartfelt Arctic Dining
service.description:
Escape the traditional restaurant setting for a seat at our private family table. More than just a meal, this is an invitation into the heart of Arctic living.

Our cooking is honest and seasonal, featuring vegetarian creations sourced from the forest or our backyard alongside traditional staples like rich reindeer stew or fresh local catch. Every plate serves as a narrative of the North. On request we can design the experience around Swedish traditions—for example a Swedish crayfish party (kräftskiva), a surströmming tasting, or afternoon tea with smörgåstårta (Swedish sandwich cake). Alcohol-free alternatives available.
service.altText: Heartfelt Arctic Dining at Vinovardag in Kiruna

service.title: ### Authentic Swedish Fika: Coffee and Conversation
service.description:
Step in from the Arctic chill for a tradition that defines Swedish culture. Fika is more than a coffee break; it is a moment to slow down and connect.

Enjoy a spread of home-baked delicacies ranging from classic cinnamon buns to cakes featuring berries foraged from the surrounding forests. We serve high-quality coffee or tea in the heart of a living and breathing family home where you can learn about life 145 kilometers north of the Arctic Circle.
service.altText: Authentic Swedish Fika at Vinovardag in Kiruna
